object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests, with blind tests written from the requirements alone for what they missed.
object.description: In a chain where a test case verifies a software requirement that satisfies a system requirement, work out the system requirements' coverage against the test document, direct and transitive, and the software requirements' transitive coverage. Expected: the system requirement is uncovered directly and covered transitively; a software requirement without a test case stays uncovered.
